name: Official human-spy travel to the established enemy persona Governor

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive()

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; if b.EnemyProgress()~='SETTLED_INITIAL' then error('enemy Governor must be established before travel') end; return b.CheckEnemy('SETTLED')
local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local target=b.EnemyTarget(); b.Queue('SPY_TRAVEL',target); return 'one official travel request queued'

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_SPY_TRAVEL' or a=='REJECTED_SPY_TRAVEL' or a=='UNKNOWN_SPY_TRAVEL' then error(a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_SPY_TRAVEL'

steps.code: ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.Queue('SAVE_TRAVEL'); return 'persist accepted travel identity for resume'

condition.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; if b.lastAction=='ERROR_SAVE_TRAVEL' then error(b.lastAction) end; return Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_SPY_TRAVEL')~=nil
